attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools (T1562.001)
attackers_goals: An attacker may abuse the audit bypass mechanism to conceal actions and evade detection.
description: A user added mailbox audit bypass for an account. This will allow the account to perform actions without being logged, and may indicate an attempt to evade detection.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection, Email
investigative_actions: Follow further actions done by the account. Verify that the configuration change was expected.
name: Exchange mailbox audit bypass
